caption: The drawing depicts an object composed primarily of wood and metal. The main body is a vertically oriented, rectangular block of coarse, textured wood, colored light brown with fine dark lines suggesting grain. The wood is bordered near the top and bottom by thick, dark brown metal bands that wrap horizontally around it. Attached to the upper portion is a metal mechanism, including a small, box-shaped compartment with a hinged latch and a circular knob. Projecting from this compartment is a curved, elongated metal lever. Rising vertically from the top front of the object is an upright piece of metal, decorated with a diamond pattern near its base; it has a notch cut into its upper edge and features zigzag elements protruding from its sides. The top of this vertical metal piece is split into two curves forming an open, U-shaped structure. The colors in the drawing are primarily natural wood tones, light beige for the background, and various shades of brown for the metallic and wooden sections. The rendering is realistic and detailed, with clear emphasis on the textures and material differences.
title: Conestoga Wagon Jacks
